product.title: Barrier Island Shelling Tour

description.text: This unique experience takes small-group on a boat tour to various destinations around Barrier Island in search of special sea shells. Tour destinations may include the Caxambas sandbars, Kice Island, Morgan Island, Second Chance Shell Bar, and others.A small group seashell hunting tour from Goodland Explore sandbars, islands, beaches, and other destinations Travel with an expert in rare and sought-after seashells Shelling tools provided: buckets, baskets, and scoopers Equipment, safety briefings, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on dolphins, shelling beaches, and Everglades wildlife. Ideal for Naples and Marco Island visitors who want shallow-water shelling, dolphin watching, and mangrove-lined routes without chartering a boat alone.
